title: fix(lint)!: os build and the object_extension publish door refuse a formula cycle an object extension adds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XH2axL4s7aEsVfT4UcgVK1P)_

Fixes #33153

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `os build`, `os validate`, `os lint` and the runtime `object_extension` publish door (Studio, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/TARGET`, the MCP and AI authoring doors) now refuse one shape an object extension could carry before: a `formula` field an extension adds that sits on a cycle of formulas (it reads itself, two added formulas read each other, or the cycle closes through a formula the target declares). No exported type or signature changes. Measured first-party exposure: 0 `objectExtensions` entries add a `formula` field (`examples/app-showcase` one entry, a `select`, a `url` and a `number` field; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` one, a `secret` field; HotCRM `origin/main` ac4dd3d has no `objectExtensions` in code), so nothing first-party is newly refused.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none owed — this PR edits `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` (the object extension paragraph names the cycle check); `skills/objectstack-formula` and `skills/objectstack-data` teach formula fields and `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields })` without saying an extension is exempt from the cycle check, so the build and the door now give the verdict the object's own formulas already get.

Precedent followed: #33216/#33217 (PR #33398), which widened the same extension walk and declared the same `no (narrowing)` / `narrowed` pair.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：对象扩展（`objectExtensions` / Studio 发布的 `object_extension`）新增的公式字段，如果引用自己，或两个互相引用，或经由对象自身声明的公式绕回来，现在在 `os build` 和运行时发布口都会被拒（规则 id `expression-invalid`，和对象自身公式循环同一句提示），位置为 `object '对象' · objectExtensions[0] · field '字段' expression`。
- **为什么改**：引擎按依赖顺序计算公式，循环里的公式永远不会被计算、每行都读到空值。此前循环检查只看对象自身声明的公式，扩展加的循环在两个入口都放行，要到读记录时才暴露。
- **风险与回滚**：收窄；第一方实测 0 处扩展新增公式字段，无既有元数据被新拒。对象自身公式循环的结论与位置不变；对象声明的公式与扩展公式构成的循环，声明那一侧仍报在对象上、只报一次；发布口不会把目标对象自身已有的循环算到扩展这次写入上。草稿保存不受影响。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（扩展遍历末尾新增的一次 `formulaCycleIssues` 调用）、`packages/lint/src/formula-cycle-issues.ts`（`extensionFormulaLoci` 与 map 形式的 `report`）、`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts`，预期 16 条全过：扩展自引用、互相引用、经声明公式绕回的循环在 build 与发布口都被拒且位置一致，链式公式和读对象公式的扩展公式通过；发布口按写入条目自身的定义判定同名字段（含与其他包同优先级或被更高优先级覆盖的情形，build 此时放行，后续卡 #33494）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (the extension walk only; the gate-setup region #33246 edits is untouched).** After each target's entries are judged, the walk runs the formula-cycle pass (#33100's `formulaCycleIssues`) over the `fieldDefs` it already builds for that target: the target as served (its declared fields with every kept entry's fields folded in through `objectsAsServed`, a tie between two packages left out), its declared fields and injected columns behind it; for a target the stack does not declare, the entries' own fields. No second fold. Each cycle member an entry adds gets a finding located at that entry, and in the build a member the authored target declares is left to the object walk, so a cycle closing through a declared formula keeps that member's location at the object and names it once. On the door's one pass the object walk does not run and the written entry is folded over the target as served before the write, so every name the entry adds is served from the entry's own record and none is left out, a name the target already serves included (review round 1).

**`packages/lint/src/formula-cycle-issues.ts`.** `formulaCycleIssues`' `report` also takes a map from field name to location. The new `extensionFormulaLoci(target, entries, left)` builds it: each name an entry adds, located `object 'T' · objectExtensions[i] · field 'F' expression` (the location the field-formula pass gives the same field), a name two entries add located at the later entry in fold order (the definition the registry serves), the caller's `left` names left out (the authored target's declared names in the build, none at the door). Kept in this module so the walk gains no new receiver for the #5017 key scan.

**Door.** `validateStackExpressions` is already on the `object_extension` door (#33072), so the roster and its pins do not move. The door's one pass reads only the written entry, and only names the entry adds are reported members there, so a cycle the target or a sibling package already carries, and a formula that only reads a cycle, are not charged to the extension write.

**`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-formula-cycle-refused.ts`**: the ADR-0087 D3 entry, its one exception stated (in `os build` on a declared target, a field two packages add at the priority that decides it is not judged; the door judges the written entry's own definition, see #33494). No D2 conversion: which read breaks the cycle is a fact only the author holds.

**`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`**: the object extension paragraph names the cycle check, its location in the build, and the door's reading of a name the target already serves.

**`.changeset/33153-extension-formula-cycle.md`**: `@objectstack/lint` minor and `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, a BREAKING banner (Before / Now / Unchanged / Fix) and `adr-0087: registered object-extension-formula-cycle-refused`.

## Why

The engine computes an object's formulas, an extension's included, in dependency order; a formula on a cycle has no order, is never evaluated and reads null on every row. The cycle check named the object's declared formulas only, so the card's probe (an extension adding `a__c = record.a__c`, or `a__c` and `b__c` reading each other) got 0 findings at both the build and the door.

## Tests

1. **`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts`**, new top-level describe `#33153` (11 cases) in the #33100 harness file, at the real gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules` with `type: 'object_extension'`) and the build (`runAuthoringRules('build', …)`):
   - LIT: an extension formula reading itself is refused at the door at the entry, in the engine's sentence (`formulaCycleMessage`); the build's finding equals the door's (where and message).
   - LIT: two extension formulas reading each other are refused on each, door and build equal.
   - LIT: a cycle closing through a declared formula: the door refuses the added member at the entry; the build names the declared member at the object (its #33100 location) and the added member at the entry, once each.
   - A cycle across two packages' extensions is named at each entry (`packages[j].manifest.objectExtensions[0]`).
   - LIT (review round 1, shape a): an extension re-declaring a field the target declares as a formula reading itself is refused at the door at the entry; the build names it once, at the object.
   - LIT (review round 1, shape b): an entry adding, as a self-reading formula, a name a sibling package's published extension already serves is refused at the door at the entry; the build over both packages (sibling priority 100, written entry 300) refuses it at the later entry.
   - Review round 2: the door judges the written entry's own definition whatever a sibling package's priority. A tie (both 200) and an outranked entry (sibling 300, written 200) are each refused at the door at the entry, while the build lets both through (it drops the tied name on a declared target and serves the outranking sibling's definition). The pin names follow-up #33494, which makes the door read the build's winner.
   - A sibling package's stored cycle, and an extension formula that only reads it, are not charged to the extension write.
   - An extension of an object the door does not carry is judged on its own fields.
   - The target's own stored cycle is not the extension write's to answer for (the differential).
   - CONTROL: an extension formula over a declared formula, and a chain inside the extension, are clean at both.
2. **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`**, new describe `[#33153]` (3 cases) through the real `saveMetaItem` + `publishMetaItem`: a self-reading formula and a two-formula cycle each get 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with the build's rule id, `where` and `path` on each member, the field is not served and the row stays a draft; a chain publishes and is served.

**Red at base:** the round-0 head tests over the base sources (`git restore --source=fc283d6d` of the two lint files): 5 of 12 red (the file then held 12 cases), every LIT plus the sibling and undeclared-target cases; controls and the differential green. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status --porcelain` empty.

**Ablations** (one-shot, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head; the tool's restore verdict each time: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- A1, the report scoping in `formulaCycleIssues` (`!report.has(field)` dropped, so every served member is reported): 5 of 12 red (round 0), including the differential case (the target's own cycle charged to the extension write) and the declared-member case (named twice). Lint tests read `src/`.
- A3 (review round 1), the door guard (`base && !extensionWrite` back to `base`, the round-0 reading): 2 of 15 red, exactly shapes a and b; and the build-side exclusion (`ownNames` emptied in the build too, behind an opaque `globalThis` marker): 1 red, shape a's build assertion (the member named twice). Both restored by the tool's verdict.
- A4 (review round 2), the same door-guard mutation at `bfa139ba`: 3 of 16 red, shapes a and b and the tie/outranked pin; restored by the tool's verdict.
- A2, the extension loci (entries read as none, behind an opaque `globalThis` marker), for the runtime pins that read lint through `dist/`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files, runtime `-t 33153`: 2 red (both LITs), the control green. Restore leg: lint rebuilt, `--absent` found the marker in 0 of 20 built files, tree clean, 3/3 green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Exposure measured:** `git grep` of `objectExtensions` / `defineObjectExtension` over `examples/`, `packages/` (non-test) and HotCRM `origin/main`: two entries, neither adds a `formula` field.
- **A field an extension redeclares under a name the target already serves** is served as the written definition. In the build the object walk judges a re-declared declared field under its name, at the object, so the extension walk leaves the authored target's declared names out rather than naming one twice. At the door, whose one pass skips the object walk and whose target is served before the write (other packages' published extension fields included), no name is left out, so both a package re-declaring a field of an object it owns and an entry re-adding a name a sibling package's extension serves are refused at the entry (review round 1, finding 1; `protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts` does not judge an extension of an object its own package owns, so nothing else refused that shape).
- **A field two packages add at the same priority**, in `os build` on a declared target, is left out of the served body (`objectsWithoutTiedFields`) and so out of the cycle pass, as #33398 leaves its hops unjudged: which definition is served is registration order. On an undeclared target the build takes the later entry's definition of a shared name and judges it.
- **The door's reading of a shared name** (review round 2): the door snapshot carries a sibling package's published extension field as a plain field with no priority, and folds the written entry over it, so the door judges the written entry's own definition of every name it adds. On a tie, or where a sibling outranks the written entry, the door can refuse a cycle the build lets through. Ruled text plus a pin, no code change here; follow-up #33494 makes the door read the build's winner. The semantic entry, the changeset's Unchanged list, the call-site comment and the docs sentence state both readings.
- **Not changed, by the order's fence:** the gate-setup region of `validate-expressions.ts` (#33246's), `authoring-rules.ts` and the door roster pins (the rule already runs on the door).

## Verification

Head `bfa139ba` (base `fc283d6d`; review round 1 adds `88b22a14` and `7c2eeb88` over `67ff848e`, round 2 adds `bfa139ba`). `origin/main` has moved to `811b976a`; `git diff --stat fc283d6d 811b976a` over every file this PR touches is empty, so no merge was needed. #33246 (PR #33434) had not merged.
